material_template_default.txt fixture -- see PROVENANCE.md.

QUOTED findings (audit sec6): ROTS is present on STRUCTURAL_PLANT_TEMPLATE
(the real file's line ~2129) and confirmed absent from PLANT_ALCOHOL_
TEMPLATE (a 60-line block in the real file), PLANT_POWDER_TEMPLATE (a
41-line block) and SEED_TEMPLATE. Each template here is abbreviated to the
handful of tokens this project's extractor reads; the real blocks are much
longer (heatdam/ignite points, solid/liquid density, and dozens of other
material properties not modelled by this schema).

[OBJECT:MATERIAL_TEMPLATE]

[MATERIAL_TEMPLATE:STRUCTURAL_PLANT_TEMPLATE]
	[STATE_NAME_ADJ:ALL_SOLID:plant]
	[ROTS]
	[ITEMS_HARD]

[MATERIAL_TEMPLATE:PLANT_ALCOHOL_TEMPLATE]
	[STATE_NAME_ADJ:ALL_LIQUID:drink]
	[ALCOHOL]
	[ITEMS_SCALED][ITEMS_SOFT]

[MATERIAL_TEMPLATE:PLANT_POWDER_TEMPLATE]
	[STATE_NAME_ADJ:ALL_SOLID:powder]
	[POWDER_MISC_PLANT]
	[ITEMS_SCALED]

[MATERIAL_TEMPLATE:SEED_TEMPLATE]
	[STATE_NAME_ADJ:ALL_SOLID:seed]
	[ITEMS_HARD]
